```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
beagle_available <- nzchar(Sys.getenv("BEAGLE_PATH")) &&
  file.exists(Sys.getenv("BEAGLE_PATH")) && nzchar(Sys.which("java"))
library(galick)
```

`run_beagle()` wraps Beagle 5.x via `processx`. The function captures
stdout, stderr, runtime, and a structured run record (input/output
SHA-256 hashes, command argv, versions) into a `galick_run` object.

This vignette runs against a real Beagle install when `BEAGLE_PATH` is
set; otherwise it explains the call without executing it.

## Locate Beagle

The package looks for Beagle in three places:

```{r, eval = beagle_available}
beagle_version()
```

If you don't have Beagle yet:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
install_beagle() # downloads pinned 5.4 jar to user cache
```

That writes the JAR to `tools::R_user_dir("galick", "cache")`. Override
with `BEAGLE_PATH` or pass `beagle_jar = ` to `run_beagle()`.

## A small phasing run

Phase a tiny VCF with no reference panel:

```{r, eval = beagle_available}
library(galick)

csv <- system.file("extdata", "tiny.csv", package = "galick")
map <- system.file("extdata", "tiny_map.tsv", package = "galick")
gt <- tempfile(fileext = ".vcf")
conversion <- csv_to_vcf(csv, map, gt)
stopifnot(conversion$ok)

out_dir <- tempfile("galick_demo_")
dir.create(out_dir)
out_prefix <- file.path(out_dir, "phased")

run <- run_beagle(gt, out_prefix, mode = "phase", nthreads = 2L)
stopifnot(identical(run$status, 0L))
run$status
run$runtime_sec
run$output_paths
```

## What's in `galick_run`

```{r, eval = beagle_available}
run
```

`run$run_record` is the path to a JSON v2.0.0 audit record that's safe
to share alongside the output:

```{r, eval = beagle_available}
jsonlite::fromJSON(run$run_record)$versions
```

## Reference panels

Reference panels for `ref =` may be plain `.vcf` or compressed `.vcf.gz`;
an index is not required. Calls must be complete, phased and diploid,
with disjoint target/reference sample IDs and matching shared variants.
Declared assembly metadata must agree; no reference FASTA is checked.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
run_beagle(
  gt,
  out_prefix,
  ref = "panel.vcf.gz",
  map = "genetic_map.txt", # PLINK genetic map (cM)
  mode = "impute",
  nthreads = 4L
)
```

## Failure modes

Pre-flight VCF validation runs `validate_vcf(target = "beagle")` on
`gt`. If it fails, `run_beagle()` raises immediately and points you at
`repair_vcf()`. Beagle's own complaints (after Java launches) come back
as a `galick_run` with `status != 0` — `summary()` shows the tail of
stderr.
